description: Fetch a public web page or document (HTML, PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, XML; up to 10 MB) and return it as clean Markdown with its title and final URL. Add render=true for pages that build their content with JavaScript: they are opened in a real headless Chrome first. Costs USD 0.002 per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base); calls that fail are not charged.

render.description: Open the page in a real headless Chrome first, for pages built with JavaScript (slower; default false)

name: url_to_markdown
title: Url To Markdown
